verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਪਰਿਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur pooran sarab miee pooran kirapaa kai paripooran kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Guru-blessed Sikh realises the universal presence of God through the total benefaction and kindness of the complete Guru who is manifestation of Supreme God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas dhiaan liv ek aau anek mek sabadh bibek Tek ekai ur aaneeaai ||

en.bdb: By absorbing the mind in the form of True Guru and contemplation of Guru's teachings, the Sikh lodges that God in his heart who is one and is present in all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੇਖਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੋ੍ਰਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil pekhataa bakataa sorataa ekai pahichaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: By keeping the vision of the eyes in the glimpse of Satguru and tuning the ears to the sound of Guru's utterances, an obedient and devoted Sikh reckons Him as the speaker, listener and watcher.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਠਟ ਨਟ ਵਟ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੯੯॥
verses.translit_en: sookham sathool mool gupat pragaT ThaT naT vaT simaran ma(n)tr man maaneeaai ||99||

en.bdb: God who is the cause of the visible and invisible expanse, who is playing the game of the world both as a performer and the apparatus, the mind of a devoted Sikh of Guru gets engrossed in words and teachings of the Guru. (99)
